turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
And how was that for you?
My wife Denise died of cancer in June of last year and the house is very quiet.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I keep coming back to it.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I have stopped cooking, I mostly eat toast and tinned soup.
What went through your mind then?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
What happened next?
I retired from the post office in December after thirty-five years and I do not know what to do with myself.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What went through your mind then?
My daughter Joy phones every Sunday from Atlanta but I tell her I am fine.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I keep coming back to it.
What went through your mind then?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
